# Relational transformation with unchanged local states and a sufficient reduction

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every law of change with moves and every reduction: some determined law on the reduced values carries every step exactly when configurations the reduction merges are taken by each move to configurations it merges; a reduced law that commutes with every move commutes with every course of moves. In the specified two-qubit real-amplitude fragment, an actual phase operation preserves both complete local densities and the joint basis distribution, while the same subsequent controlled-X gives different control responses; so the local density pair carries no law and cannot uniformly determine the next control state. A four-integer summary retaining the relevant joint cross contribution carries one, giving exact control densities and responses for every finite word of the supplied interaction and phase operations: both are instances.

Canonical source: [JointPhase.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/JointPhase.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Integer real amplitudes and density numerators; main physical witnesses divide amplitudes by sqrt 2 and densities by 2, while the final omission witnesses have norm 1. General integer-input conclusions are algebraic identities.
- H preparation, controlled-X, first-coordinate Z, partial trace and measurement interpretation are supplied by the declared quantum framework; actual joint-operation access remains required.
- All-finite-word exactness is restricted to the two specified operations and first-coordinate responses; it reuses the existing SystemsOrganization theorem preserving reached-state composition.

Two coordinates differentiate operation roles within one preparation. Phase changes the joint amplitude relation before a common interaction and measurement compare continuations. summary_update_exact supplies the old evolve_semiconjugacy premise, and summary_recovers_control connects its output to measurement. Neither the standard quantum effect nor the general reduction theorem is claimed as a new discovery.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checks 11 module theorem declarations / 25 audits, 21 empty and four using only propext. Separately credits 74 inherited theorems / 123 audits: total 148, 134 empty and 14 standard. Source, import closure, signatures and receipt bound; author counterreview, no independent-agent acceptance.

Does not prove full behavior for arbitrary complex or mixed states, a minimal summary for every operation, hardware realization, causal nonseparability, universal ontology or ethical authority. The strong zero-substantive-axiom goal for Becoming as a whole remains open.

- no_local_pair_update preserves both full local states but refutes a uniform next-step update; summary_omits_other_relations shows the sufficient summary still omits register relations, so enlarged operation scope requires renewed validation. [RelationalReduction.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RelationalReduction.lean)
- The full quantum state and specified operators explain all results equally; the obstruction targets the local reduction and does not refute the adequate conventional quantum account.
